Description: I am applying for a business zoning certificate for Oaktown as I am the new owner as of this year. I (Suzanne Howard-Carter) have bought the business from the former owner, Kristen Hopper, and am continuing with the same business name, but as an LLC. I am applying under Municipal Code 23.206.080, section B, line 6, under General Retail/Garden Center. Oaktown operates as a low-impact garden center, using only organic growing methods. We employ three people part-time. We are open for retail sales 10-5pm. We offer wholesale contract growing for restoration projects, retail plant sales and light goods. We have a curb cut on Channing and two designated parking spots at 2424 Fourth St. We continue to lease the space from PC Cargo at that address. We enjoy being a part of the Berkeley gardening community, and hope to continue at this space for another ten years. Thanks for your consideration.
